# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the EXACT tasks you broke/fixed) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — restructure prompt around the verified grading contract; 5 additive fix-clusters
- Changes I made (all in prompt.md, one restructure that PRESERVES every original rule):
  1. Grading-contract section (KNOWLEDGE): re-runs on 2 hidden inputs → compute from data, never hardcode/copy example/"wanted results" tabs; grader compares stored `.value` (int/float & numeric-strings equalize, so number/date-as-TEXT is the real failure); only values graded, not formatting. Verified against evaluation.py.
  2. "Match the examples already in the sheet" (dominant cluster, KNOWLEDGE+structure): derive one rule, verify it reproduces EVERY pre-filled example cell exactly (value/type/format/`\xa0`), don't overwrite with a different type, match empty-vs-filled convention + lookup-miss fallback. Reinforced by a pre-finish checklist.
  3. Type contract: store real number/datetime (+number_format), not strftime strings; plain string only when genuinely text.
  4. Literal-vs-formula CONFLICT resolved: keep "prefer literals" but literal must match Excel semantics; replicate the sheet's formula for Excel-specific logic (FREQUENCY/COUNTIF/INDEX-MATCH/#N/A/spill); read source with `data_only=True`; never emit a raw `"=..."` string.
  5. Formatting-only tasks: don't mutate values; hide rows to filter.
- Expected effect + why safe: fixes «redacted» (example-matching), 57090/57232/11842/38332/59743 (formula semantics + data_only), 51958 (date type), CF_11072/110-2 (format tasks don't mutate values), 450-9 (don't copy answer tab). SAFE because every rule codifies behavior the 24 passing tasks already exhibit; additions are additive/conditional; the one rewritten line still prefers literals (only adds a caveat) so no passing action flips.
- Building on prior RESULTS: none (baseline). Aligns with memory `spreadsheetbench-grading-contract`.
- Refuted hypotheses to NOT re-test: int-vs-float and numeric-string-vs-number are NOT failure causes (transform_value equalizes them) — do not "fix types" for those; 325-44's float theory is wrong on that axis.
- High-value clusters still not fully cracked: hard Excel-semantics tasks (57090 FREQUENCY numeric-only bins; 57232 off-by-one INDEX/MATCH; 59743 nested-IF blank logic) — prompt nudges toward replicating the formula but the agent may still misderive; if this lever plateaus, next try a worked openpyxl+formula example or an explicit "write the formula verbatim from the quoted current formula" rule.
- Skipped: 73-45 (INFRASTRUCTURE recalc fault — handed back), 56996 (volatile RANDBETWEEN, unwinnable), 53367 (spec ambiguity).
- Focus next iteration: read RESULT below; if accepted, target the residual hard-formula tasks with a worked example; if any passing task broke, check whether the formatting-only or literal-vs-formula wording flipped it.

> **RESULT (framework, objective):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.653 Δ=+0.093 · fixed={110-2, 3911, 50051, 51958, 73-45, CF_11072} · broke={55667}.

## Iteration cand_0002 — generalize to hidden inputs; replicate existing formulas; fix formula-recalc (incl. the 55667 regression cause)
- Changes I made (all in prompt.md):
  1. New section "Your code runs on three different inputs — make it general" (KNOWLEDGE): implement
     every stated condition even when the sample makes it a no-op & apply it to the SOURCE set; derive
     ranges/extents dynamically; never read a threshold/bound/which-cells from the answer range;
     coerce types & lock the parse convention from examples; recompute spill/array results from raw
     source (don't trust stale cached spills) and don't fabricate blanks. Targets 39046, 51359, 30709,
     59667, 38332.
  2. "Match the examples" — new bullet: if the answer range/adjacent cells ALREADY contain a formula,
     extend that SAME formula (relative refs adjust) rather than inventing logic or hardcoding. Targets
     56637, 11842.
  3. Reworked "Writing values correctly" + new "Literal value vs. live formula": corrected the parent's
     FALSE claim that recalc is unreliable (verified: harness recalcs via LibreOffice — passing 46897/
     55060/58109 write live formulas and pass); made literal-vs-formula a conditional decision; added a
     function-compatibility guard (only widely-supported functions; avoid AGGREGATE/dynamic-array/
     XLOOKUP/FILTER/LET/TEXTJOIN; strip `_xlfn.` prefix; no masking `IFERROR(...,"")`). Targets 55667,
     47741, 57090, 57232.
  4. Pre-finish checklist items (4) generality and (5) supported-function/existing-formula.
- Expected effect + why safe: edits 1–2 are additive KNOWLEDGE; the 29 passing tasks already generalize
  (pass all 3 hidden inputs) and edit 2 only fires when a formula is already present, so no passing
  action flips. Edit 3 touches the global literal-vs-formula decision (borderline UNBOUNDED) but I
  enumerated the class: passing formula tasks use only COUNTIF/IF/SUMIFS (supported → unchanged);
  passing literal-writers keep writing literals; the function guard blocks the sole regression path
  (unsupported-func formula → blank).
- Building on prior RESULTS: built on cand_0001 (ACCEPTED, fixed 110-2/3911/50051/51958/73-45/CF_11072);
  I did NOT touch those winning example-matching/type-contract rules. cand_0001 `broke={55667}` — I did
  NOT resubmit that change; instead I found its cause (AGGREGATE not recalc'd by LibreOffice → blank
  under `IFERROR(...,"")`) and added the function guard that steers 55667 to the SUMPRODUCT form its own
  passing trial t0 used.
- Refuted hypotheses to NOT re-test: "grader may not recalculate formulas reliably / prefer literals to
  avoid formulas" is FALSE — LibreOffice recalc works for supported functions (46897/55060/58109 prove
  it); the real formula risk is unsupported functions (AGGREGATE etc.), not formulas per se. int-vs-float
  and numeric-string-vs-number still do NOT matter (parent-verified).
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: 57090 (FREQUENCY ignores text-typed cells — even writing the
  formula needs the exact `COUNT(1/FREQUENCY(IF(YEAR...)))` idiom) and 57232 (GT has an off-by-one
  A2:A68×B3:B68 range + misses→0) have RESIDUAL task-specific quirks; if edit 3 doesn't land them, next
  try a worked FREQUENCY/INDEX-MATCH example. Confirmed UNWINNABLE (do not chase): 56996 (RANDBETWEEN),
  325-44 & 450-9 (buggy-macro ground truth contradicting instruction + demo tab), 5192 (contradictory
  examples), 55931 (no example/undetermined), 59743 (GT contradicts "difference").
- Plateau signal: parent used only additive-prose levers. This iteration adds STRUCTURE (generalization
  traps + existing-formula replication) and a verified fact correction. If this plateaus, switch to
  worked `<example>` exemplars for the residual Excel-semantics tasks (57090/57232).
- Focus next iteration: read RESULT below. If accepted, add a worked formula example for the residual
  FREQUENCY/INDEX-MATCH tasks. If a passing task broke, suspect edit 3 (literal→formula flip) and
  re-narrow it to only asked-for/existing-formula cases.

> **RESULT (framework, objective):** REJECTED (champion unchanged) · val=0.623 Δ=-0.030 · fixed={55667} · broke={3911, 50051, 58147}. — its WHOLE batch was reverted; re-introduce only the edits that did NOT break a task above, dropping/redesigning the ones that did.
